title: A Brownian ratchet model for DNA loop extrusion by the cohesin complex.
authors: Higashi, Torahiko L; Pobegalov, Georgii; Tang, Minzhe; Molodtsov, Maxim I; Uhlmann, Frank
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子力学模拟提出cohesin复合物挤压DNA环的布朗棘轮模型，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但属于蛋白质-DNA互作的结构与动态机制建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合研究。
abstract: The cohesin complex topologically encircles DNA to promote sister chromatid cohesion. Alternatively, cohesin extrudes DNA loops, thought to reflect chromatin domain formation. Here, we propose a structure-based model explaining both activities. ATP and DNA binding promote cohesin conformational changes that guide DNA through a kleisin N-gate into a DNA gripping state. Two HEAT-repeat DNA binding modules, associated with cohesin's heads and hinge, are now juxtaposed. Gripping state disassembly, following ATP hydrolysis, triggers unidirectional hinge module movement, which completes topological DNA entry by directing DNA through the ATPase head gate. If head gate passage fails, hinge module motion creates a Brownian ratchet that, instead, drives loop extrusion. Molecular-mechanical simulations of gripping state formation and resolution cycles recapitulate experimentally observed DNA loop extrusion characteristics. Our model extends to asymmetric and symmetric loop extrusion, as well as z-loop formation. Loop extrusion by biased Brownian motion has important implications for chromosomal cohesin function.
abstract_zh: 黏连蛋白复合物拓扑环绕DNA以促进姐妹染色单体黏连。或者，黏连蛋白挤出DNA环，这被认为反映了染色质结构域的形成。在此，我们提出一个基于结构的模型，解释这两种活性。ATP和DNA结合促进黏连蛋白构象变化，引导DNA通过kleisin N-门进入DNA抓握状态。两个与黏连蛋白头部和铰链相关的HEAT重复DNA结合模块，此时并列排列。ATP水解后，抓握状态的解体触发单向铰链模块运动，通过引导DNA穿过ATP酶头部门完成拓扑DNA进入。如果头部门通道失败，铰链模块运动产生布朗棘轮，反而驱动环挤出。抓握状态形成和解析循环的分子力学模拟重现了实验观察到的DNA环挤出特征。我们的模型扩展到不对称和对称环挤出，以及z-环形成。通过偏置布朗运动的环挤出对染色体黏连蛋白功能具有重要意义。
